title: Flags

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Choose flag proportions for viewing conditions so the city identifier remains visible outdoors.
strategic_value: A coherent range of Helsinki flag colors and logo languages can make events recognizable across different locations.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture combines purchasing guidance, flag dimensions, photographs, color/logo variants and a three-row bunting illustration.
practical_value: Choose horizontal or vertical format for pole height and wind conditions, then use the appropriate logo-language and color option.

content_islands.name: Flag selection
content_islands.spec: Keep procurement, dimensions, pole heights and color conditions together.

content_islands.name: Flags in use and variants
content_islands.spec: Show outdoor photographs followed by the horizontal, vertical and Pride-style flag range.

content_islands.name: Bunting
content_islands.spec: Close with pennant dimensions and the illustrated strings.

ingredient.name: Helsinki flags and bunting
ingredient.role: Identify civic events at outdoor scale.
ingredient.application: Choose the prescribed flag format for pole height and conditions; use the listed logo and color variants.
ingredient.scope: Horizontal flags: 250 × 150 cm for about 9 m poles; vertical: 140 × 350 cm for about 9–11 m poles. Bunting pennants: 200 × 290 mm, 10 m string, double-sided.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text explains that vertical flags fly with less wind, while horizontal flags need stronger winds.
reference_purposes.Application: It gives horizontal 250 × 150 cm and vertical 140 × 350 cm options with approximate pole heights.
reference_purposes.Constraint: A white short-term/event flag must be paired with a colorful theme/event banner; completely black flags are not recommended.
